_source: IISER Bhopal Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) Electron Microscopy unit
name: Field-Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FESEM) with EDS
model: Ultra Plus FESEM with Oxford Instruments X-Max EDS
specs: Schottky field-emission gun with 1.0 nm resolution at 15 kV and 1.7 nm at 1 kV
In-lens secondary electron, angle-selective backscattered (AsB), and Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) detectors
Gold/palladium sputter coater for non-conductive polymer, biological, and flexible-substrate samples
useCases: Microstructure inspection of printed flexible electronic sensors and microfluidic electrodes (Intisen Technology)
Surface morphology and elemental mapping of battery electrodes, thin films, and catalytic nanomaterials
bookingNotes: Samples must be completely dry and vacuum-compatible.
